# With Nextjs

Configures Next.js for the project.

## Overview

This layer includes configuration files and example components to set up a Next.js application that can use Excalidraw.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`examples/with-nextjs/next.config.js`](../examples/with-nextjs/next.config.js) | Sets Next.js configuration. |  |
| [`examples/with-nextjs/src/app/layout.tsx`](../examples/with-nextjs/src/app/layout.tsx) | Exports the RootLayout component. | `RootLayout` |
| [`examples/with-nextjs/src/app/page.tsx`](../examples/with-nextjs/src/app/page.tsx) | Exports the Page component. | `Page` |
| [`examples/with-nextjs/src/common.scss`](../examples/with-nextjs/src/common.scss) | Contains common styles for the application. |  |
| [`examples/with-nextjs/src/excalidrawWrapper.tsx`](../examples/with-nextjs/src/excalidrawWrapper.tsx) | Wraps the Excalidraw component for use in the application. | `default`, `ExcalidrawWrapper` |
| [`examples/with-nextjs/src/pages/excalidraw-in-pages.tsx`](../examples/with-nextjs/src/pages/excalidraw-in-pages.tsx) | Exports a Next.js page that dynamically loads the Excalidraw component. | `Page` |

## How it works

- `examples/with-nextjs/src/app/layout.tsx`: Defines the root layout component for the application.
- `examples/with-nextjs/src/app/page.tsx`: Defines a page component that can be extended.
- `examples/with-nextjs/src/common.scss`: Contains common styles used across the application.
- `examples/with-nextjs/src/excalidrawWrapper.tsx`: Wraps the Excalidraw component for use in the application.
- `examples/with-nextjs/src/pages/excalidraw-in-pages.tsx`: Demonstrates how to dynamically load the Excalidraw component in a Next.js page.

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `examples/with-nextjs/next.config.js`, `examples/with-nextjs/tsconfig.json`.
